name: Boba Bar
css:
/* Boba Bar: a brown sugar milk tea on a latte backdrop (original illustration). The cup sits in the free strip right of the conversation; pearls rise behind the app while the agent works, and a row of tapioca pearls over the composer fills as the context does. Light (milk tea) and dark (brown sugar) palettes. */
